# NSPanel HAUI 0.5.6

0.5.6 repairs what the one-branch cutover in 0.5.5 left behind. Deleting the `dev` branch was right, but a few places still named it, so building your own firmware failed and the README lost its screenshots.

The important one is the firmware: `esphome/nspanel_haui.yaml` fetched its vendored Nextion component from `dev`, so **every** ESPHome build of the package stopped at config validation with `couldn't find remote ref dev` — including builds whose own `ref:` already said `master`. The released `.bin` was never affected, because the release build uses the local copy of that component; only a device you compile yourself broke.

This release updates the integration and the firmware. Both TFTs are unchanged, so display version 0.4.5 remains required.

## Before updating

**If you build your own firmware**, your device YAML may still name `dev` in two places. Both must say `master`:

```yaml
packages:
  remote_package:
    url: https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui
    ref: master
    files:
      - esphome/nspanel_haui.yaml
```

The second place is inside `esphome/nspanel_haui.yaml` itself and comes with this release, so pinning `ref: master` (or `ref: v0.5.6`) is enough. After the change, **Validate** and install again.

Everything else needs no change: no TFT update, no renamed entity, no changed service, no migration. Panels already running 0.5.5 update firmware through the hub as usual.

## Fixed

- **Self-built firmware compiles again** — the vendored Nextion component is fetched from `master`, the one long-lived branch, so `esphome config` no longer fails with `couldn't find remote ref dev` ([Troubleshooting](docs/user/troubleshooting.md#esphome-stops-with-couldnt-find-remote-ref-dev)).
- **The Marketplace listing shows its screenshots** — the README's 89 images and links pointed at the deleted `dev` branch and answered 404; they name `master` now.
- **The editor footer links to a page that exists** — a development build sent its **Documentation** link to the deleted `/dev/` docs site; it opens the published docs, which carry every version.
